summary: Frontend E2E validation for 4 changes: (1) AuthPage right panel — tactical board only, (2) Language selector — accents + dark zinc-900 + gold active dot, (3) Legal module tab, (4) Legal per-prospect tab. Found 1 CRITICAL runtime bug fixed by testing agent: ScoutingLegal component was used in ScoutingModule.js (lines 168 & 1225) but never imported → app crashed with 'ScoutingLegal is not defined' the moment users clicked the Legal tab (or opened any prospect detail). Added the missing 'import ScoutingLegal from ./ScoutingLegal;'. After fix, all 4 features work end-to-end: coach login → Scouting → Legal tab renders uploader (type + Asociar-a + title + PDF picker + Subir), PDF upload succeeds (toast 'Documento subido'), doc appears in list with chip 'Contrato · General · 1 KB · fecha', view button carries ?auth token, download triggers browser download, delete removes it (returns to legal-empty). Opening a prospect card shows 3rd tab 'Legal' between Estadísticas — uploader hides Asociar-a (as required), upload/delete confined to that prospect. AuthPage HUD-free (0/9 banned strings). Language dropdown bg rgb(24,24,27)=zinc-900, active dot rgb(212,175,55)=#D4AF37, options Español/Português/Français correctly accented on both /auth (dark) and / (dark landing nav).
critical_code_review_comments: ScoutingModule.js used <ScoutingLegal /> at lines 168 and 1225 but the import statement was missing — a lint step in CI (no-undef) would have caught this. Fixed by the test agent by adding: import ScoutingLegal from './ScoutingLegal';

ScoutingModule.js is 1674 lines. It already imports ScoutingAlerts/Contacts/Map/Legal as separate files — consider extracting the remaining tab bodies (prospects, pipeline, evaluation, ranking, vitrina) into siblings to keep this file <700 lines.
LanguageSelector variant works correctly, but the active dot uses inline class 'bg-[#D4AF37]' regardless of variant — that is intentional per the spec (gold on both themes), so OK.

ScoutingLegal.js opens PDFs via a URL that leaks the JWT in the query string (?auth=TOKEN) — this is a known trade-off for direct browser tag download/preview; if the token has long TTL, consider a short-lived signed URL. Non-blocking.

AuthPage tactical board rotates every 3.5s across 6 sports — smooth and does not overlap the form. The @keyframes livePulse/blink are defined but no element references them anymore (dead style). Minor cleanup possible.

The console warning 'An error occurred in the <ScoutingModule> component. Consider adding an error boundary to your tree' was the symptom of the missing import — with the fix applied it disappears. Consider wrapping the module in an ErrorBoundary anyway so any future runtime issue does not blank the whole dashboard.

rca of the issue: Root cause: When main agent added <ScoutingLegal .../> usages inside ScoutingModule.js (module Legal tab at line 168 and prospect detail Legal tab at line 1225), they forgot to add the corresponding 'import ScoutingLegal from ./ScoutingLegal;' at the top of the file. Because JSX identifiers are validated at runtime (not compile-time in dev), the app rendered until React tried to instantiate <ScoutingLegal> and threw ReferenceError, which React caught and displayed as an overlay ('Uncaught runtime errors: ScoutingLegal is not defined'). Reproduction: login as coach → click Scouting tab → click Legal sub-tab. Mitigation applied: added 'import ScoutingLegal from ./ScoutingLegal;' next to the other Scouting* imports. Verified fix by uploading a PDF at module scope, downloading it, deleting it, then repeating inside a prospect detail (which also confirmed the prospect-select is hidden when scopeProspectId is set).
